shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && find .agents -type f | head -100 && echo "-----" && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat AGENTS.md

ls -R src index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json && echo ---- && cat src/* 2>/dev/null; echo ----; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore; echo ----; node -p "require('@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version" ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -5

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Button Avatar FileUpload Text Card Flex Label Modal ThemeProvider 2>&1 | head -150; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -E '^(tsc|vite|vitest)$'; echo ----; timeout 20 curl -sS -o /tmp/uikit7.md -w "%{http_code}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; wc -l /tmp/uikit7.md 2>/dev/null

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Button Avatar FileUpload Text Card Flex Label Modal ThemeProvider 2>&1 | head -150; echo ----; cat /tmp/uikit7.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls build 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo ----; grep -rl "useFileInput" build --include=*.d.ts | head; echo ----; find build -name "*.d.ts" | grep -E "/(components/)?(Select|Switch|Checkbox|Avatar|Button|Card|Text|Flex|Label|TextInput|controls/TextInput|Avatar|FileDropZone)/?(index)?\.d\.ts$|useFileInput|FileDropZone" | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/Select/Select.d.ts | head -150; echo ----SWITCH; cat components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; echo ----CHECKBOX; cat components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; echo ----AVATAR; cat components/Avatar/Avatar.d.ts | head -80; echo ----FILEINPUT; cat hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.d.ts

cat components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -80; echo ----TEXTINPUT; ls components/controls/ 2>/dev/null; cat components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo ----TEXT; cat components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -60; echo ----CARD; cat components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; cat components/Avatar/Avatar.d.ts | wc -l

grep -n "" components/Select/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,140p; echo ----AVATAR; cat components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts; echo ----BUTTONVIEW; cat components/Button/constants.d.ts; echo ----FILEINPUT-JS; sed -n 1,60p hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.js

cat components/Avatar/AvatarImage/*.d.ts | head -30; cat components/Avatar/AvatarText/*.d.ts | head -30; echo ----CTRL; grep -n "ControlGroupOption" -A6 components/types.d.ts | head -20; echo ----LAYOUT; ls components/layout; grep -rn "export declare const sp\b\|export declare function sp\|export declare const spacing" -r . --include=*.d.ts | head; echo ----TEXTVAR; grep -rn "header-1\|subheader-1\|body-1" components/Text/text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rln "TextVariant\|'header-1'" components/Text | head

grep -n "ControlProps" -A12 components/types.d.ts | head -40; echo ----FLEX; cat components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; ls components/layout/Flex components/layout/Box; cat components/layout/types.d.ts | head -60; echo ----SIZE; cat components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts | head -20

grep -n "wrap\|gap" components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; grep -n "wrap" components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "spacing" components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head -3; echo ----COLOR; grep -rn "ColorTextBaseProps" -A8 components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -30; echo ----DIVIDER; cat components/Divider/Divider.d.ts | head -20; echo ---ERR; grep -n "errorMessage\|validationState" components/controls/types.d.ts | head

grep -rn "TEXT_COLORS" components/Text/colorText/*.d.ts | head -3; grep -rn "export declare const TEXT_COLORS" -A3 components --include=*.d.ts | head -8; echo ---; grep -n "'" components/Text/colorText/constants.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo ---CARD-VIEW; grep -n "spacing\|BoxProps" components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head -4; echo ---; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && timeout 60 node_modules/.bin/tsc --version
node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit=$?"; node_modules/.bin/vite build --outDir /tmp/profile-build --emptyOutDir 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "vite exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
